Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions. The market's mixed signals (rally vs. jitters) mean these can move fast in either direction. Be ready to act.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and capital preservation, especially with your deeply underwater leveraged positions.
plays: Review SOXL (-84.06%), MUU (-71.11%), and SMCI (-46.17%) stops. Their current stops are far from current prices; adjust or consider cutting losses on these highly leveraged, decaying assets.
Respect the QQQ stop at 670. If it breaks, trim or exit to protect capital.
